messages:
Jordan (Partner PM): Quick sync — AWS Marketplace partner flagged discrepancies between their usage report and our billing for several Dedicated accounts (acct ids redacted). Looks like difference ~2-5% for some customers, but a few large ones are showing >20%.
billing-bot: ALERT: metering-recon failed for job metering-recon-2026-03-12 (code 409) :warning:
Priya (Eng): do we have sample partner CSV + our export for the same window?
Jordan (Partner PM): Uploaded CSV to gcs: gs://redwood-partnerships/aws-metering/reports/2026-03-12/partner-report.csv
Jordan (Partner PM): Also uploaded our usage export: gs://redwood-metering/exports/2026-03-12/redwood-usage.csv
Mark (Finance): initial thought — check entitlements vs metered dimensions. Marketplace reports on 'compute_seconds' but our invoice uses 'inference_token_units'. mapping could be off.
Priya (Eng): good point. Also timezone/windowing: partner sends events with local_ts in PST. We ingest everything as UTC and bucket hourly. If their event at 23:59 PST becomes next day UTC, counts shift.
Alex (Partnerships): pinging @Jordan — can you confirm if partner includes an idempotency/event_id per usage row? That's how we dedupe on retries.
Jordan (Partner PM): Partner schema has 'usage_id' but looks like it's not always present. They sometimes send empty string. Example row: `acct,usage_id,compute_seconds,local_ts` -> `acct-123,,3600,2026-03-12T23:59:50-08:00`
Priya (Eng): if usage_id missing we currently generate a UUID on ingest — that prevents dedupe when partner retries. We should prefer partner-supplied id if present and fall back otherwise.
Mark (Finance): for reconciliation we need stable keys. Can we ask partner to start sending a 'receipt_id' and include their invoice run id? Also we need contract-level multiplier for token_units -> compute_seconds.
Priya (Eng): quick repro I ran: `SELECT count(1), event_id FROM marketplace_events WHERE partner='aws' AND event_date='2026-03-12' GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(1)>1` returned ~42 duplicates. Suspect retries without usage_id.
Jordan (Partner PM): I'll ask partner to re-export rows for the affected accounts and include receipt_id. Also asked them to run their dedupe on our receipt if possible.
Alex (Partnerships): Proposal: engineering adds a 48-hour dedupe window using a composite key [partner, usage_id, account, dimension, window_start]. If usage_id missing use checksum of (acct, dimension, amount, timestamp). We'll log which rows were deduped.
Priya (Eng): plan: 1) quick patch to prefer partner usage_id (PR #3421), 2) new backfill job 'metering-backfill-aws-20260312' to reconcile CSV vs events, 3) schedule weekly reconciliation report in console.
Mark (Finance): timeline ok? finance needs final numbers by Monday COB for month-end close.
Priya (Eng): patch + backfill can be done by EOD Friday if no blockers. Backfill might take ~2 hours for the affected accounts.
Jordan (Partner PM): I'll coordinate partner ask for receipt_id + resend today. I'll also share a sample CSV template.
billing-bot: NOTE: reconciliation run queued (job: recon-2026-03-12). Watch logs: https://intranet.redwood/jobs/recon-2026-03-12
Elena (Sales): FYI Sales -> a couple accounts pinged us; I'm on hold for updates. Keep me posted.
Alex (Partnerships): postmortem trigger if delta >10% for any single customer. Otherwise track as operational ticket.
Jordan (Partner PM): ok — owners: Priya (eng), Mark (finance) , Jordan (partnerships). I'll create the ticket and add links.
Priya (Eng): created ticket RED-7234 and added checklist.
Jordan (Partner PM): thanks all. Will update thread after partner confirms resend. :thumbsup:
